ai_summary.key_headline: Messi-led Albiceleste Brace for Desert Foxes' Aggressive Counter

argentina.philosophy: Positional overload with fluid movement around Lionel Messi.

algeria.philosophy: Compact defensive block with quick direct play through the channels.

tactical_insights: Argentina's possession will focus on creating overloads on the right wing to free up Messi in the half-spaces.
Algeria will look to exploit spaces left behind Argentina's attacking fullbacks via Bennacer's long-range distribution.
Mac Allister's ball recovery rate will be critical in stopping Algeria's central counter-attacking transitions.
